description: This file defines a ContentDetailsController class for managing the state and interactions related to content details in a Flutter application. It handles loading content data, managing watchlist status, playback progress, download state, and cache updates.

classes.name: ContentDetailsState
classes.description: An enum representing the different UI states for content details, including loading, ready, not found, and error.

classes.name: ContentDetailsController
classes.description: A Flutter ChangeNotifier that manages the state, data fetching, and user interactions for content details in the app.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches content details, watch progress, watchlist membership, and download status; updates UI state accordingly.

methods.name: toggleWatchlist
methods.description: Adds or removes the content item from the user's watchlist stored in cache.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Refreshes the content details from the cache, typically triggered by cache-buster events.

methods.name: playPressed
methods.description: Handles the play button press to resume playback or start after a pause.

methods.name: updateProgressSeconds
methods.description: Updates playback progress both locally and in the repository.

methods.name: recordPlaybackProgressSeconds
methods.description: Backward-compatible method to record playback progress.

methods.name: recordPlaybackCompleted
methods.description: Marks the content as watched/completed in the repository.

methods.name: markDownloadEnqueuedLocally
methods.description: Updates local download state immediately after enqueueing a download.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up listeners and marks the controller as disposed.
